connectors_setup.title: Connectors installed?
connectors_setup.description:
Before using GSOS, install these Anthropic Connectors via Claude Desktop Settings → Connectors:
• Notion (Anthropic official)
• Google Calendar (Anthropic official)
• Circleback (https://claude.com/connectors/circleback)

GSOS will abort with a 1-click recovery URL if any connector is missing. Check this box once all three are connected.
